features.N_gesture: Extended empty hand or raised open palm; distinguish separate held object.
features.W_branch: Held narrow stem with distinct branching or lobed terminals.
features.S_long_tool: Held long shaft with a widened fibrous-looking bundle at an end, rather than merely a bend.
features.S_spindle: Separate slender shaft with fusiform/whorl-like thickening; say where both ends terminate.
features.S_thread: Fine continuous connection between the two distinct implements/hands, rather than independent closed bead-like outlines.
features.S_links: Hanging series of individually outlined rounded links or beads.
features.E_frame: Held framework with a main rod and separated cross-ended/transverse terminals, not only one bulb/neck outline.
features.E_winding: Lines wound on or linking that frame and a separate implement/hand.
features.E_vessel: Single enclosed rounded bulb narrowing into a neck with a distinct rim/opening-like top.
features.center: Describe central object and how figure bodies meet the shared boundary; descriptive only.
